--[[
mirait0waGUI - ULTIMATE GLOBAL CHAOS
✅ Skybox HD (No Atmosphere/Invisible Fix)
✅ Decal Spam (6-Sides All Parts)
✅ Particle Spam (All Players)
✅ Global Music (Pitch 0.1, Volume 5.0)
--]]

local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

-- CONFIG
local IMAGE_ID = "rbxassetid://91763768533864"
local MUSIC_ID = "rbxassetid://77484784570543"

-- ==========================================
-- 1. FIX LIGHTING & SKYBOX (CLEAR HD)
-- ==========================================
-- Buang segala benda yang buat skybox invisible
for _, v in pairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
    if v:IsA("Atmosphere") or v:IsA("Clouds") or v:IsA("Sky") or v:IsA("PostProcessEffect") then
        v:Destroy()
    end
end

Lighting.FogEnd = 100000
Lighting.ClockTime = 14
Lighting.Brightness = 2 -- Bagi texture nampak terang

local sky = Instance.new("Sky", Lighting)
sky.Name = "mirait0wa_ULTIMATE_SKY"
sky.SkyboxBk = IMAGE_ID
sky.SkyboxDn = IMAGE_ID
sky.SkyboxFt = IMAGE_ID
sky.SkyboxLf = IMAGE_ID
sky.SkyboxRt = IMAGE_ID
sky.SkyboxUp = IMAGE_ID
sky.SunAngularSize = 0
sky.MoonAngularSize = 0

-- ==========================================
-- 2. GLOBAL MUSIC (PITCH 0.1)
-- ==========================================
local function playMusic()
    -- Buang sound lama kalau ada
    local oldSound = Workspace:FindFirstChild("GLOBAL_CHAOS_MUSIC")
    if oldSound then oldSound:Destroy() end
    
    local sound = Instance.new("Sound", Workspace)
    sound.Name = "GLOBAL_CHAOS_MUSIC"
    sound.SoundId = MUSIC_ID
    sound.Pitch = 0.1
    sound.Volume = 5.0
    sound.Looped = true
    sound:Play()
end
playMusic()

-- ==========================================
-- 3. DECAL SPAM ALL PARTS (6 SIDES)
-- ==========================================
for _, obj in pairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
    if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
        local faces = {
        Enum.NormalId.Front, Enum.NormalId.Back, 
        Enum.NormalId.Top, Enum.NormalId.Bottom, 
        Enum.NormalId.Left, Enum.NormalId.Right
        }
        for _, face in pairs(faces) do
            local d = Instance.new("Decal", obj)
            d.Texture = IMAGE_ID
            d.Face = face
        end
    end
end

-- ==========================================
-- 4. PARTICLES SPAM (PLAYER ONLY)
-- ==========================================
local function applyParticles(char)
    local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
    if root then
        local pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter", root)
        pe.Texture = IMAGE_ID
        pe.Rate = 120
        pe.Size = NumberSequence.new(3, 7)
        pe.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(2, 5)
        pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(5, 15)
        pe.VelocityInheritance = 0.5
    end
end

-- Apply pada semua player (sedia ada & baru masuk)
for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if p.Character then applyParticles(p.Character) end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(applyParticles)
end)

-- MESSAGE NOTIFICATION

msg.Text = "SERVER HAS BEEN TAKEN OVER BY mirait0WAGUI"

msg:Destroy()

print("ULTIMATE GLOBAL SCRIPT DEPLOYED!")
